notes: All 29 source and 32 target IDs are partitioned exactly once.

The ASV inverts מְלֹא הַמַּחְתָּה as a censer full: the construct keeps full, the article goes unrepresented because no the is written for the phrase (rule 29's last sentence), and the indefinite a joins the noun under rule 15.
The supplied of before coals and before sweet incense is each the following nominal's own rendering under rule 33; the second unit is discontinuous around the attributive sweet.
it after bring is added — הֵבִיא carries no object suffix, and rule 44 forbids folding an unsupported object pronoun into the verb.
